youtube_description:
It’s a great day for the Slugs & Bugs Show! Join musician Randall Goodgame, Doug the Slug, Sparky the Lightning Bug, Morty and Maggie Raccoon, and a slew of special guests inside the brand-new Slugs & Bugs Workshop. Imaginations are kindled, songs are sung, and hijinks are uncovered, along with timeless truths about life and faith. From a producer of VeggieTales, the Slugs & Bugs Show is delightful, quirky, hand-crafted fun for kids of all ages.

For more info, visit: http://slugsandbugs.com

Subscribe to the Slugs & Bugs Channel here: https://www.youtube.com/channel/UC4ZnK7U7Sx0BbHdl5tu7OcA

For more music and stories full of faith and fun and silliness - for your kids and the
whole family, visit us at http://slugsandbugs.com

The Slugs & Bugs Show is a production of Brentwood Studios. Founded in 2008 by former VeggieTales executives, the Nashville-based studio partners with producers and content owners to develop family brands that kids love and parents appreciate. The Slugs & Bugs Show includes 26 episodes including the special “Make Ready for Christmas” with Scott Hamilton, Ellie Holcomb, Andrew Peterson, and others. Brentwood Studios believes creative storytelling is an immensely valuable tool to equip families for meaningful conversations and learning experiences. Learn more at http://www.brentwoodstudios.net
